svg.title: Run-out measurement – drawing 44-05
svg.text: Run-out measurement – screw between centres (or in V-blocks)
Circular run-out (ISO 1101) at 5 stations: TIR = max − min reading during one full turn
dial gauges 1 µm (or laser / LVDT sensors) – the screw turns slowly by hand or by the drive
V-block alternative: the thread lies on 2 V-blocks with balls in the groove = the thread axis is the datum;
the dial gauge on the journal then shows the journal run-out to the thread axis (what the bearing really sees).
Centres = datum of all grinding – a dirty or damaged centre gives false run-out.
